title: Cleaner home: work photos
question: Where do work photos live on Josh's home? All three use the phone's own picker, show a saving bar on each photo, and turn a failed photo amber with a retry. Clock-out stays one tap, so the 'no photos yet' nudge sits in the clocked-out receipt. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: A Photos row under the pass
options.lineage: Same hairline status rows as 'At the gym' and 'Need more time?'
options.thesis: Photos are one more status row, with a thumbnail strip inside it. One tap opens the picker.
options.viewport: Greeting · black pass · At the gym · Work photos 5 of 10 with strip · Need more time? · red Clock out.
options.risk: The quietest option: photos look like everything else in the list, so they could be overlooked.

options.label: B Ten slots on the pass
options.lineage: The pass's progress line, repeated as a count of ten
options.thesis: The pass shows ten small slots under Worked / Left, so you can see at a glance how many photos are in.
options.viewport: Black pass with progress line, stats and a 'Photos 3 of 10' slot line · At the gym · red Clock out.
options.risk: The pass gets busier, and adding photos takes two taps (slot line → sheet → Add photos).

options.label: C Camera beside Clock out
options.lineage: Docked actions, like a camera app's shutter bar
options.thesis: A camera button sits in the dock beside Clock out, so photos are always one thumb tap away.
options.viewport: Greeting · pass · rows · upload tray above a dock of [camera 3/10] + red Clock out.
options.risk: Camera right next to Clock out: a missed tap clocks someone out, which only Carly can fix.
